message.content: {"skills": [{"category": "diagnosis", "trigger": "When evaluating a chest X-ray with bilateral pulmonary opacities to distinguish organizing pneumonia from other interstitial or alveolar processes.", "steps": ["Identify the distribution and morphology of opacities, specifically looking for patchy, ill-defined consolidations that are predominantly peripheral or subpleural.", "Distinguish from community-acquired pneumonia by confirming the absence of dense, homogeneous lobar consolidation confined to a single anatomical segment.", "Distinguish from acute eosinophilic pneumonia by verifying the opacities are patchy/peripheral rather than diffuse ground-glass opacities."]}]}
